newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT calls Wyser-Pratte move disruptive.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT calls Wyser-Pratte move disruptive.

text.p: COMSAT Corp said on Tuesday that Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Providence Capital Inc's moves to call for a special meeting and remove a voting rights limit are disruptive and do not recognize the restructuring the company is undergoing.

A spokesman for COMSAT said that a proxy fight will "be highly disruptive and interfere with the strategic plan, diverting management's time and energy away from the important inititiatives it has begun in order to refocus this committee and enhance the value for all shareholders. "
COMSAT said it announced a restructuring plan two weeks ago and it has spent that time meeting with shareholders.
COMSAT said it had offered to meet with Wyser-Pratte and Providence to address their concerns.

"Now they apparently intend to embark on a course of action that will be long and costly for all concerned, involving as many as three separate proxy contests over the next six to nine months," a spokesman for COMSAT said.
